**Yes, but not by Michael Torres alone.** On 2025-09-23 BlueRiver was eligible for a $200,000 limit. Under the 2025 Credit Policy, a limit that size needed approval from the Finance Manager, Priya Shah.

**1. The request.** CR-9206 asks to raise C-1002's limit from $100,000 to $200,000. It is dated 2025-09-23 and was submitted by michael.torres@northstar.example. The justification is fleet expansion, so it rests on the customer's own standing, with no guarantee involved. CR-9206 is not in the `credit_requests.csv` extract, so I used the ERP record you supplied.

**2. The customer.** ERP C-1002 "Blue River Logistics LLC" is the same company as CRM-2051 "BlueRiver Logistics". Both records show 890 Harbor Way, St. Louis, MO and DUNS 07-331-9025. The CRM tier is **Standard**.

**3. The policy.** CREDIT-POLICY-2025 (effective 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) applies. Its payment rule allows no invoice paid or unpaid more than 45 days past due. The maximum limit for a Standard account is $300,000. No concurrence is required.

**4. Payment history.** This covers invoices due from 2024-09-23 to 2025-09-22:

| Invoice | Due date | Paid | Days late |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-61005 | 2025-03-01 | 2025-02-26 | on time |
| INV-61210 | 2025-05-30 | 2025-05-28 | on time |
| INV-61433 | 2025-08-29 | 2025-09-02 | 4 days |

All three are within the 45-day rule. The 52-day-late INV-62147 was due in 2026, so it is outside this window.

**5. Maximum limit.** The maximum is $300,000. No guarantee covers BlueRiver. The requested $200,000 is within the maximum, so the customer is eligible.

**6. The requestor's authority.** As VP Sales, Michael Torres has no credit-approval authority under the policy. Only Accounts Receivable Specialists, the Finance Manager and the Director of Finance hold credit authority.

**7. The required approver.** A limit above $50,000 and up to $750,000 needs Finance Manager approval. That role is held by **Priya Shah**, who did not submit the request, so separation of duties is satisfied. No concurrence is required in 2025.

  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9206", "customer": "Blue River Logistics LLC (ERP C-1002 / CRM-2051 BlueRiver Logistics)", "current_limit": 100000, "requested_limit": 200000,
              "date": "2025-09-23", "requestor": "Michael Torres (VP Sales)", "basis": "standard"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 300000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2025 §5: Standard account maximum $300,000; no guarantee; no invoice in the 12 months before the request more than 45 days late (INV-61433 paid 4 days late)", "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2025", "requestor_limit": null, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Finance Manager",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Priya Shah", "role": "Finance Manager", "kind": "approval"}]},
  "evidence": ["Request record CR-9206 as supplied (Northstar ERP)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1002)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2051, Standard)", "structured/erp_credit.csv (C-1002 limit $100,000)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv (INV-61005, INV-61210, INV-61433)", "documents/credit_policy_2025.md", "structured/employees.csv", "documents/organization_chart.md"],
  "missing_evidence": []
}
```
